austin.summary: Austin, drafting fifth means you waited, and then you struck twice — Linnea at #5 and Jenna at #6, back-to-back. Nobody has scored yet; you sit at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, all 4 of 4 still in the game, and 114 points still on the table. Your build is people-people: an entrepreneur, a photographer, a farmer, a counselor. Calm heads, warm hearts, real grit. I love it.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Linnea Capobianco is your headliner at pick #5 — rational, outgoing, optimistic, a 25-year-old entrepreneur who says yes to anything uncomfortable and prefers calm heads over paranoid ones.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Nothing has gone wrong yet — but Carter at #15 and Eric at #16 came late in the snake, and this whole roster leans on charm and connection in a game that eventually asks somebody to swing the axe.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Tribes are still TBA, so watch where these four land — Jenna's lifelong-fan strategy and Eric's bond-fast theater energy could look very different depending on who they wake up next to.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you drafted third and built a roster with range: a chef who adapts anywhere, an HR head who's warm on top and cutthroat underneath, an attorney who wants allies who think nothing like her, and a superfan game designer chasing the dream of his life. Nobody's played a beat yet — you sit at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, 4 of 4 still in the game, 114 points still on the table. Everything's in front of you.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Aaliyah Puglia came off the board at pick #3 as your headliner — confident, wise, and a chef who's spent her life doing a lot with a little.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: You've got "chaotic" listed twice on this roster in Cristian and Kilby, and chaos is a gorgeous thing until it's pointed at your own alliance.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Tribes are still TBA, so watch where Alexis lands — she's hunting alliance partners who think nothing like her, and that first division will tell you everything.

tami.summary: Tami, you had first crack at the whole board and you took the sociology professor who's been studying this game her entire life. Then you stacked a federal prosecutor, a baseball executive, a gate agent with Boston Rob swagger, and an OB/GYN resident behind her. Nobody's played a minute — you're rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, 5 of 5 still in the game, and 114 points still on the table. That's a brainy, likable, loud roster. Let's get to it!

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Angelica "Jelly" Loblack went pick #1 for a reason — a PhD before 30, curious, multifaceted and passionate, and she calls this game the social experiment she trained for.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Rob Antonson at pick #20 calls himself a total city boy who's not an outdoors type, so he's leaning entirely on those social skills, and Sharonda Cox came to you at pick #21 as a leftover.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Every tribe on your roster is still TBA, so the first thing to watch is where these five land and whether Patt finds the risk-taking partner in shenanigans he's asking for.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and built something loud. A crisis manager, a personal trainer, a voice actress and a pro wrestler — four different engines, all still in the game, four of four. You sit at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 0 counted points, same as everybody, and there are 114 points still on the table. Nobody's played a beat yet. But on paper? That's grit, hustle and mischief. I like the makeup.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger, your pick #2, has been applying since the middle of season one and arrives at 49 as the oldest player of the season — determined, joyful, and long overdue.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Nothing's gone wrong yet with 0 counted points across the board, but Ana calls herself goofy, ambitious and chaotic, and chaos cuts both ways out here.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Every tribe is still TBA, so the story to follow is where Ori and Brady land and whether that intensity reads as trust or as threat on day one.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted with a theme and I respect it. Two farmers, an actor, and a medical student — dirt under the nails and charisma to burn. Lewis at #4, Maggie at #7, Devin at #14, Thien An at #17: all four in the game, zero counted points, and you're tied at rank 1 of 5 with 114 points still on the table. Nobody's ahead of you. Nobody's behind. Tribes TBA — and that's the fun part.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Lewis Kelly is your headliner at pick #4 — cheeky, devilish, charming, a Dublin-born farmer living in a renovated school bus in Puerto Rico and smarter than he lets on.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Devin says loyalty and honesty keep him close but a single lie sends him looking elsewhere — on Survivor, that clock starts ticking day one.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Two farmers on one roster — watch whether Lewis and Maggie land on the same tribe and whether Thien An's quick wit turns those early camp connections into real alliances.
